PP_DrvIntro: PhantomPad needs two official, free drivers by Nefarius. They come inside PhantomPad, nothing is downloaded.
PP_DrvViGEmText: Creates the virtual Xbox controller that games see. Required.
PP_DrvHidHideText: Hides the physical controller from games so buttons are not doubled. Recommended.
PP_DrvRebootNote: Done. Restart the PC so HidHide starts working. Save what you have open before restarting.
PP_DrvAllOk: Everything is installed. PhantomPad is ready.
PP_DrvNote: When you press "Install all", the official installers open one after the other: accept the Windows notice and follow their steps. HidHide asks to restart the PC at the end. You can also install them later from Settings → Hide controllers.
